$comment: Reference copy of design section 4's state table. NOT wired into any build. windows-client/sidecar/src/status.ts (T-002) and windows-client/ui/src/status.js (T-006) each implement it independently; windows-client/tools/contract-check.mjs (T-008) is what catches them drifting apart. label is a template: {ss} = whole seconds until nextRetryAt, zero-padded to 2 and capped at 99; {status} = HTTP status; {flags} = raw Pause_EX1 bitmask.

states.label: SIDECAR STARTING
states.enteredWhen: Process start, before the config file has been read.

states.label: NO CONFIG
states.enteredWhen: The config file does not exist at the resolved path. First run.

states.label: CONFIG INVALID
states.enteredWhen: The config file exists but is unparseable or fails validation. The sidecar stays alive and waits for a config control message.

states.label: UPLINK STOPPED
states.enteredWhen: Config is valid and the uplink is not running: either never started (autoUplink false) or stopped by the user.

states.label: UPLINK ACTIVE
states.enteredWhen: A start control message has been accepted and not yet stopped.

states.label: SIDECAR FAULT
states.enteredWhen: The child process exited without a shutdown control message. Synthesised by the Rust supervisor; the sidecar never emits it.

states.label: SIDECAR RESTART
states.enteredWhen: The supervisor is within its restart budget and is respawning the child.

states.label: SIM LINK STANDBY
states.enteredWhen: The uplink is not running, so no SimConnect connection is attempted.

states.label: SIM LINK CONNECTING
states.enteredWhen: open() has been called and has neither resolved nor rejected.

states.label: SIM LINK ONLINE
states.enteredWhen: recvOpen received. attempt resets to 0.

states.label: SIM LINK RETRY {ss}S
states.enteredWhen: A connect attempt failed, or an established link dropped (quit/close/error), and the next attempt is scheduled at 5 s doubling to a 60 s cap.

states.label: ACARS STANDBY
states.enteredWhen: The uplink is not running: nothing is posted and nothing is probed.

states.label: ACARS CONNECTING
states.enteredWhen: The uplink has started and no request has completed yet.

states.label: ACARS UPLINK
states.enteredWhen: The most recent frame or event POST returned 2xx. This exact string is the frozen acceptance-criterion label.

states.label: ACARS READY
states.enteredWhen: No ingest POST in the last 15 s (the sim link is down, so there are no frames), but the reachability probe got an HTTP response. The server is up; there is simply nothing to send.

states.label: ACARS REJECT 401
states.enteredWhen: An ingest POST returned 401: the ingest token does not match the server's.

states.label: ACARS FAULT {status}
states.enteredWhen: An ingest POST returned a non-2xx status other than 401.

states.label: ACARS CERT FAULT
states.enteredWhen: The request failed with a TLS error code (DEPTH_ZERO_SELF_SIGNED_CERT, SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN, UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE, ERR_TLS_CERT_ALTNAME_INVALID, CERT_HAS_EXPIRED): the certPath is wrong, missing, or does not cover the host in serverUrl.

states.label: ACARS NO COMM
states.enteredWhen: The request failed at the transport layer (ECONNREFUSED, ETIMEDOUT, ENOTFOUND, EHOSTUNREACH, abort).

states.label: PAUSE OFF
states.enteredWhen: Pause_EX1 flags are 0, or the legacy Unpaused event fired before any Pause_EX1 was seen.

states.label: SIM PAUSED
states.enteredWhen: Bit 1 (full) or bit 2 (with-sound) set and bits 4 and 8 clear; or the legacy Paused event before any Pause_EX1.

states.label: ACTIVE PAUSE
states.enteredWhen: Bit 4 set. Highest precedence: Active Pause is the one the legacy events never report.

states.label: SIM MENU
states.enteredWhen: Bit 8 set and bit 4 clear: the sim itself is frozen, typically a menu or loading screen.

states.label: PAUSE {flags}
states.enteredWhen: Non-zero flags with no known bit set — a future SDK bit. Shown raw rather than swallowed.
